decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce. The deck also aims to manipulate card selection and generate card advantage through cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm, as well as having access to efficient removal through Lightning Bolt. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Maddening Hex to gain card advantage and control the board state.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Bonecrusher Giant to apply pressure. The inclusion of dragon-themed cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance adds a thematic element to the deck. With a focus on fast, efficient plays and disruptive elements, this deck looks to close out games before the opponent can establish their own strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control over the game by using a variety of powerful spells and planeswalkers to disrupt the opponent's strategy. With cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Narset, Parter of Veils providing card advantage and disruption, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Life from the Loam helps to provide additional value and resilience, while cards like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending deal with threats efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win through incremental advantage.

A fast-paced deck that focuses on quickly developing a board presence and disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal spells. It utilizes a mix of efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, alongside disruptive cards like Daze and Force of Will to control the tempo of the game. The deck also features versatile threats like Brazen Borrower and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure and close out games quickly. By efficiently using its resources and maintaining a proactive game plan, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in order to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game instantly by stacking the deck in a specific order. It includes various cantrips and control elements to find and protect the combo pieces, as well as fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond to speed up the process. The deck aims to efficiently manipulate its library and resources to set up a winning sequence and disrupt opponents with counter magic and hand disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to use powerful creatures and planeswalkers in combination with disruptive artifacts and fast mana sources to put intense pressure on opponents early in the game. By utilizing cards like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Ensnaring Bridge, along with fast mana from Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's options and disrupt their game plan while quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster. The deck's strategy is to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond effectively.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and efficiently bring powerful creatures onto the battlefield by using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Simian Spirit Guide. By utilizing these cards in combination with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze, the deck can overwhelm opponents with big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and find the necessary combo pieces.

The main concept of this deck is to use low-cost spells and creatures to put pressure on the opponent and control the game tempo. By utilizing cards like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, it aims to quickly establish a board presence while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with threats and maintain board control. Lastly, the deck utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for more threats and answers, providing consistency and flexibility in gameplay.

The deck focuses on utilizing Aluren to combo off by casting creatures for free and generating value through their enter the battlefield abilities. The deck includes disruptive creatures like Leovold and Endurance to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also having a resilient and powerful finisher in Acererak. The deck also has efficient removal in Abrupt Decay and card advantage engines like Uro and Baleful Strix. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while also allowing for consistency through fetch lands and cantrips.

The focus of this deck is to utilize the Bomberman combo of Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate infinite mana and bring back Walking Ballista from the graveyard to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also uses Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Lotus Petal, while Karn, the Great Creator acts as a versatile tool box option. Additionally, Thought-Knot Seer and Gyruda, Doom of Depths provide disruption and card advantage to support the combo win condition. The mana base is optimized to support the powerful interactions of the deck.

The deck focuses on using Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Indestructible Flying Avatar token as quickly as possible. It includes cards like Vampire Hexmage and Hex Parasite to remove ice counters from Dark Depths, as well as Expedition Map to search for the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption like Thoughtseize and Duress to protect the combo, as well as cards like Opposition Agent to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to assemble the Dark Depths combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly reduce your own life total to make Death's Shadow a powerful threat while utilizing aggressive tempo plays and disruption to control the game. By cycling cards like Street Wraith and utilizing cards like Snuff Out and Hymn to Tourach, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Gurmag Angler. The deck also utilizes counterspells like Force of Will and Stubborn Denial to protect its threats and control the board. The mana base includes fetch lands and Wasteland to ensure consistent mana development while disrupting the opponent's mana base.

The key concept of this deck is to create a powerful combo using Mystic Forge and Grindstone. By using cards like Mox Opal, Manifold Key, and Helm of Awakening, the deck aims to accelerate the combo and make it more efficient. Defense Grid and Pithing Needle are included to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and access to artifacts from outside the game. The deck also includes cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal for additional mana acceleration, and Painter's Servant to synergize with Grindstone.

The deck focuses on cheating powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul onto the battlefield quickly through cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. It also includes protection spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to ensure the combo goes off successfully. With the help of acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with massive creatures early on, while also having alternative win conditions through Archon of Cruelty and Brazen Borrower.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient mana generation and card draw to quickly assemble the Storm combo pieces necessary to cast a lethal Tendrils of Agony. It includes a variety of tutors, cantrips, and hand disruption spells to find and protect key cards, while also featuring protection in the form of Veil of Summer. The goal is to generate a large storm count through the casting of multiple spells in a single turn, ultimately finishing the game with a high-powered Tendrils of Agony to defeat the opponent.

The deck revolves around generating mana quickly using cards like Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond, to then cast multiple spells in a single turn to storm off and win the game with Tendrils of Agony or Burning Wish. It also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to protect the combo. Veil of Summer provides protection from opposing disruption spells, while cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder help dig for combo pieces. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a high storm count.
